entries.title: A bare-ticker NSE/BSE join stamps one company's ISIN, BSE code and BSE shareholding split onto a different company (live: NSE FOCUS = Focus Lighting carries Focus Business Solution's INE0DXR01010 / 543312)
entries.repro: curl '127.0.0.1:52152/resolve?q=FOCUS' -> best = NSE 'Focus Lighting and Fixtures Limited' with isin INE0DXR01010 and bse_code 543312, and a BSE candidate 'Focus Business Solution Ltd' with the SAME isin + bse_code. BSE's own header API for 543312 answers ISIN INE0DXR01010, IT-software (= Focus Business Solution). curl '127.0.0.1:52152/disclosures/shareholding?symbol=FOCUS' -> Focus Lighting's NSE patterns carry split_source='BSE' / split_as_of 2026-03-31, i.e. the institutional/public-float split was merged from scrip 543312, a different company, and shown as true.
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:418-421 (bse_scrip_code keys the BSE master on the bare ticker), sidecar/services/corporate_disclosures.py:499-530 (_merge_bse_split takes the split for that code), sidecar/services/bse_provider.py:628-631, sidecar/services/resolution_policy.py:33-35 + :92 (_residual_tie: equal bare ticker = same instrument), sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:869-879 (enrichment guard says the opposite), :236, :840, :673; https://api.bseindia.com/BseIndiaAPI/api/ComHeadernew/w?quotetype=EQ&scripcode=543312 -> "ISIN":"INE0DXR01010","Industry":"Computers - Software & Consulting". Severity: refuter held medium on the /resolve observation alone; upgraded to high by the merger because the same ticker-string join also drives the BSE shareholding-split enrichment, so another company's money-relevant ownership numbers are served labelled split_source=BSE (critical-class for the affected tickers; high because the collision set is a small NSE-SME/BSE-only minority, count unmeasured).
entries.root_cause: Instrument identity is decided by the bare ticker string in three places with three contradictory rules (_residual_tie: same ticker = same instrument; enrichment guard: same ticker across exchanges = different companies; dedup: (symbol, exchange)), and ISIN, the real identity key carried on every Indian instrument, drives none of them; bse_scrip_code/ISIN enrichment joins NSE rows to the BSE master by ticker, so a same-ticker different-company pair cross-stamps identity and downstream BSE lanes fetch the wrong company. Same root cause as COD-resolver-1 per the refuter.
entries.fix_shape: One same_instrument(a, b) predicate (ISIN when both carry one, else (symbol, exchange)) used by the rename gate, _residual_tie and the dedup; make the NSE->BSE enrichment join refuse a BSE row whose name/ISIN disagrees (never copy isin/bse_code across a ticker-only match; run enrichment before the rename lane, symbol_resolver.py:673), and have bse_scrip_code take the bound instrument (or its ISIN) instead of a bare ticker. Pin with a test: resolve('FOCUS') yields two instruments with distinct ISINs, and get_shareholding('FOCUS') on NSE carries no BSE split (split_source None) when the BSE scrip's ISIN differs.

entries.title: resolve() re-runs a 300-900 ms SequenceMatcher scan over ~17.9k master names on every call with no result memo
entries.repro: sidecar/.venv/bin/python with _live_lookup stubbed to []: symbol_resolver.resolve('infosys','IN') costs ~313 ms on EVERY repeat; 'hdfc bank limited results' ~897 ms; exact ticker 'TATASTEEL' 0.1 ms; autocomplete 3 ms.
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:747, :750, :754, :592, :117, :1033; refuter admitted (medium).
entries.root_cause: Masters are lru_cached but _resolve_masters (banded fuzzy scan) is not; only the network rung has an LRU + cooldown.
entries.fix_shape: @lru_cache(maxsize=2048) on the pure _resolve_masters(query, region) (rename + enrichment stay outside it) plus cache_clear() in reset_caches_for_tests; test: a second identical resolve() does not call SequenceMatcher (patch counter) and returns an equal Resolution.

entries.title: The agent's resolve_symbol tool gets a drifted copy of the Instrument wire shape: no rename provenance (effective date / note), confidence rounded differently
entries.repro: Compare routers/resolve.py _instrument_payload vs agent_tools/resolve_symbol.py _instrument_dict for a renamed symbol: router emits a 'rename' block and confidence=round(score,4); the agent tool emits only former_name and round(score,3). No test binds the two.
entries.evidence: sidecar/routers/resolve.py:27, :36, :46; sidecar/services/agent_tools/resolve_symbol.py:25, :33; refuter admitted (medium).
entries.root_cause: The Instrument->wire projection is hand-maintained in two files and has already drifted.
entries.fix_shape: One instrument_payload() in the resolver package imported by both call sites (the tool drops keys by name, not by re-implementation); parity test asserting the tool's dict is a subset of the router payload for a renamed fixture, including the rename block.

entries.title: An India-region user's screener opens on the S&P 500: the FR-060 region-aware default (default_universe_for_region) has no caller, while the router docstring claims it is shipped
entries.repro: Set region IN, open the Screener panel -> universe dropdown = 'sp500'. grep default_universe_for_region over sidecar/src/types/plugins -> only its def, __all__ and the router docstring.
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/screener.py:114-117, :1323; sidecar/routers/screener.py:74-77; src/store/screener.ts:267 (store.ts:654 is __resetForTests, not user-facing); refuter admitted_with_correction (high->medium).
entries.root_cause: The store hardcodes universe: 'sp500' at init; the region-aware selector was written but never wired.
entries.fix_shape: Initialise the store's universe from the region surface on first mount via default_universe_for_region (or its TS equivalent), and correct the docstring; vitest: with region IN the initial universe is the India default; with US it stays sp500.

entries.title: The witness family's 'is this an Indian listing' and 'is this a block error' predicates are copied across three modules each (plus _row_value and is_india_target twins), so witnesses can silently disagree about when to fire
entries.repro: design - grep 'def is_applicable' / 'def _is_blocked' under sidecar/services: is_applicable byte-identical in market_cap_witness, ownership_check, range_check; _is_blocked identical in ownership_check, range_check, dividend_actions; is_india_target in both research/disclosures.py and research/relevance.py (fast.py imports the other copy).
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/market_cap_witness.py:98, sidecar/services/ownership_check.py:94, :107, sidecar/services/research/range_check.py:121, :179, sidecar/services/earnings_quality.py:134, sidecar/services/research/disclosures.py:101, sidecar/services/research/relevance.py:374; refuter admitted_with_correction (3 identical copies, not 5; medium).
entries.root_cause: Two decisions (Indian-listing test, block-error set) held in 3+ files each.
entries.fix_shape: One services/witness.py exporting is_india_listing(symbol) and is_block_error(exc) (+ one is_india_target), imported by every witness; a test that each witness module's predicate IS the shared function (identity check), so a re-copy fails.

entries.title: runScreener duplicates the unary-fallback and run-completion protocol three times, with the superseded-run guard held only by a comment
entries.repro: design - the 'POST /screener/run -> guarded set(lastResult/status/error) -> null abort controller -> return' sequence at store.ts:401-420 (network-error fallback), :423-442 (404 fallback) and the stream tail :551-564, each with its own isCurrent()/aborted ordering; invariant only in the :30-36 comment.
entries.evidence: src/store/screener.ts:30, :403, :425, :562; refuter admitted (medium).
entries.root_cause: Protocol duplicated instead of structured; one careless edit lets run A's cleanup clobber run B's state.
entries.fix_shape: Local finish(patch) { if (!isCurrent()) return; set(patch); _runAbortController = null } and one runUnary() helper; vitest: start run A, start run B, resolve A's fallback late -> B's lastResult/status untouched.

entries.title: Disclosure lane loops (announcements, shareholding) catch only ProviderError, so any other lane exception 500s the whole route instead of degrading to a partial merge
entries.repro: Make bse_provider.get_shareholding raise KeyError: via _merge_bse_split it degrades; via get_shareholding's lane loop (:396-402) it propagates and GET /disclosures/shareholding returns 500 (surfacing as a bogus CORS error) although the NSE lane succeeded. Same for get_announcements (:297-302).
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/corporate_disclosures.py:25-27, :300, :399, :514-519; sidecar/routers/disclosures.py:68, :110; refuter admitted_with_correction (high->low: every realistic lane failure is already converted to ProviderError; no reachable non-ProviderError path found).
entries.root_cause: Lane loops guard only ProviderError while the enrichment path in the same file guards Exception for the documented reason.
entries.fix_shape: Widen both lane loops to except Exception (they already record the reason into errors); test: a lane raising KeyError yields 200 with the other lane's rows and the error listed.

entries.title: The provider registry's preference-order fallthrough catches only ProviderError, so a non-ProviderError from a provider skips the remaining candidates
entries.repro: design (latent) - _resolve_sync / _resolve_async `except ProviderError`; a parse KeyError/ValueError from a non-last provider would escape and 500 without trying the next candidate.
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/provider_registry.py:360, :410; sidecar/services/india_provider.py:104, :147, :189; refuter admitted_with_correction (high->low: every cited trigger is already wrapped or indexes provider-owned columns; yfinance is the last candidate).
entries.root_cause: Registry seam trusts every provider to translate every failure into ProviderError.
entries.fix_shape: Catch Exception in both resolvers, log with provider id, fall through, re-raise only when no candidate remains; test with a stub provider raising KeyError followed by a working one -> the second answers.

entries.title: Five divergent 'is this a Yahoo rate limit' predicates feed one shared breaker
entries.repro: design - yfinance_provider matches type name OR 'Too Many Requests' in message; growth_check/dividend_history/earnings_quality match type name or 'ratelimit' in name; symbol_resolver checks the exact type name.
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:38, sidecar/services/growth_check.py:160, sidecar/services/dividend_history.py:74, sidecar/services/earnings_quality.py:210-214, sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:1006; refuter admitted_with_correction (medium->low: pinned yfinance 1.3.0 raises YFRateLimitError for every 429, which all predicates match).
entries.root_cause: Throttle classification duplicated and already drifted; no live trigger today.
entries.fix_shape: One provider_health.is_rate_limit(exc) = union of both predicates, imported at all five sites; test the union on YFRateLimitError, an HTTPError('429 Too Many Requests') and a *RateLimit* class.

entries.title: data_cache never evicts: stale rows are read past TTL and left, and invalidate/clear/size have no production callers
entries.repro: design - data_cache.get leaves a stale row in place; grep sidecar/services + routers for data_cache.invalidate/.clear/.size -> zero non-test hits; every symbol viewed leaves permanent rows (earnings:<sym>:*, disclosures:<sym>:*, ratings:<sym>:*).
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/data_cache.py:107, :152, :168, :174; sidecar/routers/earnings.py:80; sidecar/routers/fundamentals.py:221; refuter admitted_with_correction (medium->low: operator's long-lived data_cache.db is 2.6 MB; growth is tens of MB at most).
entries.root_cause: Unbounded cache with dead eviction API.
entries.fix_shape: DELETE the expired row on the stale-read path in get() (or a row-count cap with oldest-first eviction in set()); test: a stale get() removes the row.

entries.repro: design - routers/fundamentals.py:206-222, :225-241, :244-260 differ only in cache-key suffix, model and service fn; each ends with except ProviderError: raise HTTPException(502), identical to app.py:312-315.

entries.fix_shape: One _cached(key, ttl, model, fetch) helper (shared with the earnings router, see the earnings entry with the same defect_class) and delete the three except blocks; existing router tests pin behaviour.

entries.title: SEC store select* helpers call getState() instead of being selectors, so panel reactivity rests on a separate hook plus a `void x;` statement
entries.repro: design (latent) - drop the `void filingsByIdentifier;` line AND the now-unreferenced useMemo dependency (as react-hooks/exhaustive-deps would suggest) in SecFilingsPanel.tsx:74-77 -> the panel freezes at first render with no error.
entries.evidence: src/store/sec.ts:17-21, :52-65, :274-297; src/modules/sec/SecFilingsPanel.tsx:40, :74-77; src/modules/sec/InsiderTradingTable.tsx:105-115; refuter admitted_with_correction (high->low: deleting only the void line does not freeze; needs the dep dropped too).

entries.title: EarningsCalendarPanel hand-rolls a table (sortable header, null glyph) instead of DataTable and duplicates its seven column widths between skeleton and loaded table

entries.title: Analyst/earnings modules carry an unreachable error banner, an unwired 'analysts' sort key, triplicated fmtDate, duplicated rating label/colour maps and a false sort comment
entries.repro: design - (a) AnalystRatingsPanel `tabError && tabData !== null` banner is unproducible (store sets error only on cache miss, clears on success); (b) SortKey 'analysts' has a sortValue case but no header wires it; (c) RATING_LABEL/RATING_COLOR/fmtDate byte-identical across two tables, fmtDate a third copy in EarningsCalendarPanel; (d) EarningsSurpriseChart.tsx:102 comment says reverse, code sorts ascending.
entries.evidence: src/modules/analyst-ratings/AnalystRatingsPanel.tsx:152-164; src/store/analyst-ratings.ts:55-71; src/modules/earnings/EarningsCalendarPanel.tsx:22, :39-43, :63-64, :317-322; src/modules/analyst-ratings/IndividualAnalystTable.tsx:11-31; src/modules/analyst-ratings/RatingsHistoryTable.tsx:15-35; src/modules/earnings/EarningsSurpriseChart.tsx:102; refuter admitted (low). entries.title: The three Instrument builders default band=BAND_FUZZY, so autocomplete ships an exact-ticker row as score=1.0/band=0 that resolution_policy.decide() would refuse to bind
entries.repro: rows = symbol_resolver.autocomplete('TATASTEEL','IN'); rows[0] -> score 1.0, band 0; resolution_policy.decide(Resolution(query='TATASTEEL', best=rows[0], candidates=rows)).outcome == 'disambiguate'.
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:468, :483, :497, :952, :961, :965; sidecar/services/resolution_policy.py:124; refuter admitted_with_correction (medium->low: no production path feeds autocomplete rows to decide()).
entries.root_cause: A defaulted structural field makes the wrong value the easy one.
entries.fix_shape: Delete the '= BAND_FUZZY' defaults and make autocomplete state its band; test: exact-ticker autocomplete row carries the exact band and decide() binds it.

entries.title: Resolution.needs_disambiguation and the DISAMBIGUATION_THRESHOLD re-export are dead second-decision surfaces kept alive only by tests
entries.repro: design - needs_disambiguation re-runs decide() per access with zero non-test callers; DISAMBIGUATION_THRESHOLD is in __all__ with no consumer.
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:86, :250, :258, :1042; sidecar/tests/test_symbol_resolver.py:96; sidecar/tests/test_resolver_rename.py:93; refuter admitted (low).

entries.fix_shape: Delete both; switch the four test call sites to resolution_policy.decide(...).outcome.

entries.title: matched_criteria is computed and shipped on every screener row, read by nothing, and always empty under a group ('match ANY') run
entries.repro: Run the screener with a group present -> every row has matched_criteria: []; on the flat branch it is always [0..n-1]; no frontend reader.
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/screener.py:363-374, :394; types/screener.ts:176; src/lib/host-actions.ts:1155; refuter admitted_with_correction (medium->low; the flattenLeaves mirror in host-actions must STAY - it drives the simple builder view via applyFilters, store.ts:302-309).

entries.fix_shape: Delete matched_criteria from the engine, ScreenerResultRow and types/screener.ts (keep host-actions flattenLeaves); or populate it on the group path if the column is wanted.

entries.title: POST /screener/run's ValueError->400 handler teaches a false fact about the engine and would misreport an internal model bug as a client error
entries.repro: design - the except ValueError comment says an unknown universe raises ValueError in the engine; unknown universe is a Literal -> 422 and resolve_universe raises ProviderError; a pydantic ValidationError/FormulaError from an internal bug would surface as 400 instead of 500.
entries.evidence: sidecar/routers/screener.py:84; sidecar/services/screener.py:214, :260; sidecar/models/screener.py:205-238; sidecar/services/screener_formula.py:78; refuter admitted_with_correction (low).
entries.root_cause: Stale defensive handler with a wrong comment.
entries.fix_shape: Delete (or narrow to FormulaError with an honest comment) the except branch.

entries.title: compute_range builds its 52-week window twice with the same predicate, deriving coverage_days and the bar count from different lists
entries.repro: design - `windowed` and `windowed_ts` are two comprehensions over `stamped` with the identical `ts >= window_start` filter (:159-163).
entries.evidence: sidecar/services/research/range_check.py:159, :160, :163; refuter admitted (low).
entries.root_cause: Duplicated predicate guarding the coverage floor that stops a thin series emitting a false 52-week high.
entries.fix_shape: Build one list of (ts, bar) pairs and derive both from it; existing range_check tests pin output.

entries.title: FieldMeta.status is a closed union in TypeScript but an unvalidated str in Pydantic
entries.repro: FieldMeta(status='unavaliable') validates on the Python side; the TS consumer silently shows no chip.
entries.evidence: sidecar/models/fundamentals.py:23-33, :39; types/data.ts:179; src/modules/equity/EquityOverviewPanel.tsx:190-220 (degrades safely); refuter admitted_with_correction (medium->low).
entries.root_cause: Invariant held by a docstring instead of the type.
entries.fix_shape: status: Literal['ok','withheld','unavailable']; pytest that an unknown status raises ValidationError.
